capabilities: sync book highlights into Markdown notes grouped by chapter
create one note per book with blockquotes and notes underneath
rewrite only a managed zone between gs:start and gs:end markers
pause or resume syncing per book via the gs-state property
configure folder, file-name prefix, heading level, and note label
extras: Community listing shows a 'not yet reviewed by the Obsidian team' notice; the plugin has passed automated checks but not manual review, and the author notes it is unofficial and unaffiliated with the Grimmory project.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import highlights and reading notes from a self-hosted Grimmory instance.

relations.evidence: syncs your book highlights and notes from a self-hosted Grimmory instance into your vault

summary: Sync plugin that pulls book highlights and notes from a self-hosted Grimmory instance into vault notes as chapter-grouped blockquotes.
